# Linkbot

> Linkbot replaces public career exposure with permissioned, private eligibility.

## What this site is

The official site for Linkbot, a privacy-first matching layer for the labour
market. Public career profiles have become attack surfaces. Linkbot gives
people a private, verifiable record of who they are and what they are
eligible for, and lets employers request access to specific signals — with
the holder's consent.

## Status

Private beta, invitation-led. Onboarding runs in small cohorts (roughly 20
people at a time) to keep matching quality high, for a first cohort of senior
professionals and a first cohort of employers with specific roles. An API is
in private testing; endpoints that could bypass the consent layer are not
exposed publicly.

## Who operates it

Linkbot OÜ, registered in Tallinn, Estonia. Operated by a small team across
Europe and Africa.

## Core pages

- [Home / Overview](/): the problem, the position, and the private-beta access
  request.

## Hosts

Every URL in this file is root-relative on purpose. The canonical host is
resolved at build time (astro.config.mjs `site`) and is deliberately not written
here: a static file carrying a literal host would name the wrong origin in every
other environment, and no host this organisation does not control may appear in
this file at all. See docs/preview/domain-migration.md.

## Contact

- Email: hello@linkbot.org — access requests and general enquiries.
- [Access request form](/#access)

## What this site is not

- It is not a recruiter database.
- It is not a public profile host.
- It is not a job board. There are no real job listings on this site: the
  `/jobs` route is a preview of the discovery experience, built on clearly
  labelled synthetic sample data.
- It does not expose API endpoints that could be used to bypass the consent
  layer.
